document_meta.revised_by: PLANNING agent — after owner-supplied old-POS screenshots + codebase pattern audit
document_meta.scope: CR-069 (Phase 1 — Employee Management) AND CR-070 (Phase 2 — Role Management). CR-071 (Phase 3 — Role Gating) has no dedicated screens; it wires gates into existing screens.
document_meta.principle: Reuse the established MyGenie POS design system verbatim. This is a MIGRATION — retain muscle memory. Old POS aesthetic IS the design language; we're rebuilding it as clean React 19 + shadcn + existing shared primitives, not reinventing.

COLORS.primaryOrange: #F26B33  — back-arrows, top-nav title accent, active-status highlights, focus rings
COLORS.primaryGreen: #329937  — primary CTAs (Save, Edit, Add, +), active tab underline/bar, positive states, toggle-ON
COLORS.grayText: #666666  — secondary text, form labels (small caps in shared.jsx)
COLORS.borderGray: #E5E5E5  — form field borders, row separators, cards

brand_and_tokens_authoritative_source.old_pos_confirms: Screenshots at /app/memory/evidence/CR-069/old_pos_reference/ show EXACTLY these tokens — orange back-arrow on the ← icon, green title 'Employee Mgmt' / 'Roles Mgmt' / 'Edit Employee' / 'Edit Role', green rounded '+' add-button, green full-width 'Edit' primary button, grey pill-shaped inputs on white bg.

typography.font_source: existing app (do NOT re-import a new font like Plus Jakarta Sans — the app already uses its own stack; introducing new fonts violates the migration principle). Verify what fonts are currently loaded via /app/frontend/src/index.css or App.css before touching.
typography.note_for_impl_agent: If the app currently ships without a custom font (system stack), keep it. If a custom font is loaded, keep it. This CR does not introduce typography changes.

must_reuse.name: FormContainer
must_reuse.usage: Every Add/Edit form wraps in this. Props: title, onBack, onSave, footerRight. Provides consistent orange back-arrow header + sticky green Save button.

must_reuse.name: ListItem
must_reuse.usage: Row in the Employees table + Roles table. Props: onEdit, onDelete, testId, children. Handles hover state and right-aligned actions.

must_reuse.name: TextInput
must_reuse.usage: Name, Phone, Email, Password fields on Employee form + Role Name on Role form. Rounded pill; floating label; consistent focus ring.

must_reuse.name: SelectInput
must_reuse.usage: Role dropdown (Employee form), Role Type dropdown (Role form).

must_reuse.name: ToggleSwitch
must_reuse.usage: Employee Active/Inactive column toggle; Role Status toggle.

must_reuse.name: BoolBadge
must_reuse.usage: Bill User View 'Yes/No' chip (backend value verbatim per R9).

primitive_reuse_MANDATORY.no_new_primitives_unless: Only add a new primitive if the old POS shows a control that shared.jsx lacks. Currently identified gap: none for Phase 1/2. For Phase 2 Permission Matrix we may need a CategoryAccordion, but see below.

layout_and_route_pattern.route_pattern: Follow CR-041 / CR-059 / CR-060 established pattern — a Page in /app/frontend/src/pages/ + a Panel/View in /app/frontend/src/components/. Route registered in App.js.
layout_and_route_pattern.recommended_route: /employees (or /employee-management) — top-level, NOT nested under /settings. Old POS shows Employee Mgmt as a first-class module. Confirm placement with owner.
layout_and_route_pattern.page_shell: Same shell as MenuManagementPage.jsx / ExpenseEntryPage.jsx: <Sidebar/> + main content with bg-[#F7F7F7] and margin-left synced to sidebar-expanded state.
layout_and_route_pattern.pattern_B_list_form_swap: Use `viewMode` state ('list' | 'form') to swap between List view and Add/Edit form IN-PLACE (not modal). This matches: (a) old POS UX exactly — Edit Employee is a full-page view, not a Sheet; (b) settings/ListFormViews.jsx precedent.

structure: Left: orange back-arrow icon (←, ArrowLeft from lucide-react, color: COLORS.primaryOrange) + Title text (color: COLORS.primaryGreen, text-xl font-semibold)

Right: [Download icon button (grey/muted, color: COLORS.grayText, hover: darkText) for CSV export] + [Green round + button (bg-[#329937] rounded-full w-9 h-9, white Plus icon inside)] — 12px gap between them
top_header_bar_pattern.sub_header: Under top bar: SEGMENTED TAB switcher (Employees | Roles). Active tab: bg-[#329937 opacity=15%] with text-primaryGreen font-semibold + green underline bar. Inactive: gray text on transparent bg. Full width, single row. Rounded top corners. See old POS screenshot 01 + 03.
top_header_bar_pattern.search_bar: Full-width rounded pill input (border-borderGray bg-white), placeholder 'Search'. Search icon on right (lucide Search, grayText).

system_role_banner.component: grey pill/chip centered under search bar
system_role_banner.content: 'System Role : {list-of-role-type-names}' — where role-type-names come from all-role-list.role_types (STATION, Waiter, Manager, Billing, Server Waiter, Delivery) OR from role-list.roles filtered by is_system_role=true. Owner said to clarify during design brainstorm; both semantics exist in the data.
system_role_banner.styling: bg-[#F0F0F0] text-grayText text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full

columns_matches_old_pos_verbatim.content: Two lines: Line 1 = f_name (+ l_name if present) in text-sm text-darkText font-medium. Line 2 = employee id (e.g., '4784') in text-xs text-primaryOrange (matches old-POS blue but we align to brand orange) — clickable to copy. Line 3 = phone number in text-xs text-grayText. Right side of column: chevron > icon (lucide ChevronRight, primaryOrange) OPTIONAL — collapse for now; add later if detail-panel is needed. Right side: phone icon (lucide Phone, primaryOrange) — tel: link click-to-call.
Plain text of employee.role.name — NO badge, matches old POS which shows role as plain text (e.g., 'captain', 'Owner', 'KDS').
Right-aligned: pencil edit icon (lucide Pencil, size-4, primaryOrange) + ToggleSwitch (Active/Inactive, mapped to employee-status endpoint status:0/1).

SCREEN_1_employee_list.column_widths: Details ~50% / Role ~25% / Action ~25% — old POS uses this proportion.
SCREEN_1_employee_list.row_hover: bg-[#F7F7F7]; cursor default; only the icons in Action column are clickable.
SCREEN_1_employee_list.empty_state: 'No employees found. Click + to add your first employee.' Centered, text-sm grayText. Bring the green + button visually to attention with a subtle pulse or arrow annotation.
SCREEN_1_employee_list.loading_state: shadcn Skeleton rows (3-5) using same column widths.
SCREEN_1_employee_list.not_in_this_screen: bill_user_view, mac_ip_kds/bill/bar, email, image — old POS list view doesn't show these. Match verbatim.

SCREEN_2_employee_form.route: same route, viewMode='form' — in-place swap (NOT modal, NOT Sheet)
SCREEN_2_employee_form.wrapping: Use FormContainer from shared.jsx with title='Edit Employee' or 'Add Employee'.
SCREEN_2_employee_form.section_1_title: General Information (with expand/collapse chevron — accordion, expanded by default). Matches old POS.

fields_ordered_matches_old_pos.label: Password

hidden_fields_OQ15_owner_pending.bill_user_view: API round-trips this Yes/No. Old POS form does NOT show it. Send 'No' as default. Confirm with owner before shipping — OQ-15 open.
hidden_fields_OQ15_owner_pending.mac_ip_kds / mac_ip_bill / mac_ip_bar: API round-trips these. Old POS form does NOT show them. Send empty string or null. Confirm with owner — OQ-15 open.

footer.left_button: Reset — light grey, disabled when form is pristine (matches old POS). test_id='employee-form-reset-button'
footer.right_button: Edit (on edit-mode) or Save (on add-mode) — full-width green (bg-primaryGreen), text-white. test_id='employee-form-save-button'. This matches old POS exactly.

SCREEN_2_employee_form.validation: Inline red text under each field. Phone must be 10 digits. Email must match /.+@.+\..+/. Password min 6 chars (or match backend policy — verify with owner OQ-6). Confirm password must match password.
SCREEN_2_employee_form.on_save_success: toast('Employee added' / 'Employee updated') + return to list viewMode with fresh fetch.

columns_matches_old_pos_verbatim.content: Line 1 = role.name (text-sm darkText font-medium). Line 2 = updated_at date formatted DD/MM/YYYY (text-xs primaryOrange). Right side: chevron > icon (primaryOrange) — optional expand.
Comma-separated preview of first 3–4 modules with '…' ellipsis when longer. E.g., 'Manager, food, pos, order, bill, a…'. text-sm grayText multi-line.

SCREEN_3_role_list_CR070.system_roles_HIDDEN_from_table: Filter roles where is_system_role=true (or is_editable=false — verify both). Show them ONLY in the grey pill banner under search bar.

fields.label: Role Type
fields.note: SINGLE-select. Options source = role-master-list ('All Role' as first item = null template, then Accountant, Billing User, Captain, Cashier, Delivery Boy, Manager, Owner, Station (Chef), Waiter(S), Waiter(T)). Selecting a template AUTO-LOADS the template's default_modules[] into the Permission Matrix (see brainstorm note below).

OWNER_BRAINSTORM_REQUIRED.context: Owner: 'so we might some info in terms of making it easy for user how it works during design phase we will brianstorm this'
OWNER_BRAINSTORM_REQUIRED.issue: The Role Type dropdown does double-duty — categorization + defaults-loader. Users may not realize that changing Role Type mid-form OVERWRITES their permission selections.
proposed_UX_options_for_owner_to_pick: A) On Role Type change, show a confirm dialog: 'Load default permissions for {Type}? This will overwrite your current selections.'
B) Show an info banner under the Role Type field: 'Selecting a Role Type pre-fills the permission checklist. You can add or remove permissions afterward.'
C) Show a small (i) tooltip icon next to 'Role Type' label with the explanation.
D) Combination: banner (B) + confirm dialog on subsequent changes (A). Recommended default.

structure.layout: 2-column grid of checkboxes with label; row height compact (~40px); tiny (i) tooltip icon next to each label showing description if available
structure.search_within: optional filter chip 'Search permissions…' at top of first accordion

selection_helpers: 'Select all in this section' checkbox at the accordion header level (indeterminate state when partial).
Live counter in each accordion header: '(15 of 27 selected)'.
Overall counter above section 2: 'Selected: X of 52 permissions'.
section_2_permission_matrix_ACCORDIONS_n.R9_typo_preservation: Render labels EXACTLY as backend returns in all-role-list.role_modules[*].name — including 'Expence', 'sattle report', 'report summery', 'Complementary Food', 'complementary_food', 'revenue report_average'. NEVER autocorrect. Add code comment: // CR-070 R9 — backend labels are canonical
section_2_permission_matrix_ACCORDIONS_n.checkbox_source_of_truth: Backend key is role_pass_value (e.g., 'expence', 'sattle_report'). Send verbatim in modules[] array of role-add/role-update payload.

SCREEN_4_role_form_CR070.system_protected_read_only: If editing a role where is_editable=false, the entire form enters read-only mode: all inputs disabled, top of form shows a lock badge 'System Protected — {protection_level}', Reset+Edit buttons hidden, replaced by 'Close' button. This is defensive UX only; system roles shouldn't reach this screen since they're filtered from the list.

Tab switcher (Employees | Roles) — Roles tab shows placeholder 'Coming soon in Phase 2 (CR-070)' toast when clicked, until CR-070 ships
Sidebar: unflag employee-management from comingSoon, wire to /employees route
cr070_phase2_deliverable_checklist: Role Type auto-loader UX (per owner brainstorm decision)
Sub-task noted: Role Definitions doc — canonical default-permissions spec per Role Type. Produced during CR-070 design phase as owner deliverable.

accessibility_notes.focus_ring: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#F26B33] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons (orange, per brand).
accessibility_notes.aria: aria-label on all icon-only buttons (Pencil = 'Edit {name}', Phone = 'Call {phone}', Download = 'Export CSV', Plus = 'Add {entity}').
accessibility_notes.keyboard: Tab order strictly top-to-bottom-then-left-to-right in forms. Enter submits form. Escape from form returns to list (with dirty-state confirm).
accessibility_notes.screen_reader: Table has proper <thead>/<tbody> structure. Toggle status announces 'Active/Inactive' via aria-checked.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use transition-colors duration-150 on hover states. Never transition: all.
motion_and_interactions.tab_switch: 150ms opacity fade of underlying content; no slide/wipe.
motion_and_interactions.form_swap: Instant — no animation between list ↔ form (matches old POS).

instructions_to_implementation_agent: 1. Import COLORS from '../../constants' — do NOT hardcode hex.

2. Reuse FormContainer, TextInput, SelectInput, ToggleSwitch, ListItem from '../panels/settings/shared.jsx' — do NOT invent new primitives unless the pattern in the old POS is missing (see 'no_new_primitives_unless' note).
3. Follow the Page + Panel pattern from ExpenseEntryPage.jsx / MenuManagementPage.jsx. Panel holds all logic, Page is a thin shell with <Sidebar/> + main.
4. Use Pattern B (viewMode state 'list' | 'form') for the list↔form swap — NOT a Dialog / Sheet.
5. For CR-070 permission matrix: use accordion (native <details> or a small custom component matching shared.jsx aesthetic). DO NOT use shadcn Tabs.
6. Preserve R9 typos verbatim in all labels and permission keys.
7. Every interactive element gets a data-testid per the registry above.
8. Toast via useToast from '../../hooks/use-toast' — same as ExpenseEntryPanel.
9. Icons from lucide-react ONLY. No emoji, no Font Awesome.
10. CR-069 (Phase 1) — DO NOT touch any file listed in R5 hotspots or R6 sacred logic. Zero role gating in Phase 1.
